tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the free partner signup URL and the program list.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List every Empire company in the partner network with status, commission and buyer discount.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Get the caller's existing tracked link and promo code. Create links in the partner dashboard or API first. Requires the partner API key.

tools.name: my_stats
tools.description: The caller's tier, links, clicks, conversions and commission totals. Requires the partner API key.

tools.name: creative_kit
tools.description: Post copy (with #ad disclosure), banner and video URLs for a company.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_link · Private data: get_link, my_stats · Public sink: creative_kit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_link · Private data: get_link, my_stats · Public sink: creative_kit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
